+  border-color: #ffb914
+}
+
+@keyframes rainbowShimmer {
+  0% {
+    transform: translateX(0)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: translateX(88.88889%)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes rainbowShimmerPosition {
+  to {
+    background-position: -200% 0
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeIn {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeInScaleUp {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(.6)
+  }
+
+  50% {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1.1)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeInScaleUpNoOversize {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(.8)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes shake {
+  0% {
+    rotate: 3deg
+  }
+
+  5% {
+    rotate: -2deg
+  }
+
+  10% {
+    rotate: 2deg
+  }
+
+  15% {
+    rotate: -3deg
+  }
+
+  20% {
+    rotate: 0deg
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes loadingShimmer {
+  0% {

+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: none
+  }
+}

+@keyframes topRightStackIn {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translateX(1.5rem)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: translateX(0)
+  }
+}

+.SegmentedToggle {
+  background-color: #3c4b68;
+  border: 1px solid #0f0f0f;
+  border-radius: 0;
+  box-shadow: .2rem .25rem 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, .32);
+  display: flex;
+  flex-shrink: 0
+}
+
+.SegmentedToggle .SegmentedToggleOption {
+  background: none;
+  border: none;
+  color: #cfcfcf;
+  cursor: pointer;
+  font: inherit;
+  min-width: 5.5em;
+  padding: .4em 1em;
+  position: relative
+}
+
+@media(pointer:coarse) {
+  .SegmentedToggle .SegmentedToggleOption:before {
+    content: "";
+    inset: min(0px, (100% - 44px)/2) min(0px, (100% - 44px)/2);
+    position: absolute
+  }
+}
+
+.SegmentedToggle .SegmentedToggleOption:before {
+  inset-inline: 0
+}
+
+.SegmentedToggle .SegmentedToggleOption:not(:first-child) {
+  border-left: 1px solid #0f0f0f
+}
+
+@media(hover:hover) {
+  .SegmentedToggle .SegmentedToggleOption:hover {
+    background-color: #394980;
+    color: #fff
+  }
+}
+
+.SegmentedToggle .SegmentedToggleOption.pad-focused {
+  background-color: #394980;
+  color: #fff
+}
+
+@media(hover:none) {
+  .SegmentedToggle .SegmentedToggleOption:active {
+    background-color: #394980;
+    color: #fff
+  }
+}
+
+.SegmentedToggle .SegmentedToggleOption:focus-visible {
+  outline: 2px solid #ffb914;
+  outline-offset: -2px
+}
+
+.SegmentedToggle .SegmentedToggleOption.SegmentedToggleOptionSelected {
+  background-color: #2e80ee;
+  color: #fff;
+  cursor: default
+}

+.GameInformation {

+  isolation: isolate;
+  z-index: 1
+}
+
+.GameInformation.GameInformationFadeIn {
+  animation-duration: .3s;
+  animation-duration: .2s;
+  animation-fill-mode: backwards;
+  animation-iteration-count: 1;
+  animation-name: fadeIn;
+  isolation: isolate
+}
+
+.GameInformation.GameInformationReleaseCountdown .CustomLobbyListInner,
+.GameInformation.GameInformationReleaseCountdown .GameInformationBottom .LobbyCollectionHeader,
+.GameInformation.GameInformationReleaseCountdown .GameInformationTopBackgroundImage,
+.GameInformation.GameInformationReleaseCountdown .GameInformationTopLeftBody {

+
+.GameInformation .GameInformationInner {

+@keyframes rainbowShimmer {
+  0% {
+    transform: translateX(0)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: translateX(88.88889%)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes rainbowShimmerPosition {
+  to {
+    background-position: -200% 0
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeIn {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeInScaleUp {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(.6)
+  }
+
+  50% {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1.1)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeInScaleUpNoOversize {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(.8)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes shake {
+  0% {
+    rotate: 3deg
+  }
+
+  5% {
+    rotate: -2deg
+  }
+
+  10% {
+    rotate: 2deg
+  }
+
+  15% {
+    rotate: -3deg
+  }
+
+  20% {
+    rotate: 0deg
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes loadingShimmer {
+  0% {
+    transform: translateX(-66.6666666667%)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: none
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes topRightStackIn {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;

+

+    transform: translateX(0)
+  }
+}
+
+.PurchaseWelcome {

+

+
+.ShaderPackCategory .ShaderPackSummary .ShaderPackDescription {

+}
+

+  gap: .5rem
+}
+
+.ShaderPackCategory .ShaderPackSummary .ShaderPackStatus.Ready {
+  color: #1dd06d
+}
+
+.ShaderPackCategory .ShaderPackSummary .ShaderPackStatus.Failed {
+  color: #ff8a80
+}
+
+.ShaderPackCategory .ShaderPackSummary .ShaderPackStatus.OffInStrict {
+  color: #fcd373
+}
+
+@keyframes rainbowShimmer {
+  0% {
+    transform: translateX(0)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: translateX(88.88889%)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes rainbowShimmerPosition {
+  to {
+    background-position: -200% 0
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeIn {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeInScaleUp {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(.6)
+  }
+
+  50% {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1.1)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeInScaleUpNoOversize {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(.8)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes shake {
+  0% {
+    rotate: 3deg
+  }
+
+  5% {
+    rotate: -2deg
+  }
+
+  10% {
+    rotate: 2deg
+  }
+
+  15% {
+    rotate: -3deg
+  }
+
+  20% {
+    rotate: 0deg
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes loadingShimmer {
+  0% {
+    transform: translateX(-66.6666666667%)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: none
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes topRightStackIn {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translateX(1.5rem)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: translateX(0)
+  }
+}
+
+.ShaderPackDropZone {
+  align-items: center;
+  border: 1px solid #ffb914;
+  border-radius: 0;

+  display: flex;
+  flex-direction: column;

+  justify-content: center;
+  min-height: 12rem;
+  padding: 2rem 1rem
+}
+
+.ShaderPackDropZone .ShaderPackDropZoneIcon {
+  font-size: 3rem;

+}
+
+.ShaderPackDropZone .ShaderPackDropZoneInstructions {

+  text-align: center

+
+.ShaderPackDropZone .ShaderPackDropZoneButtons {

+}
+
+.ShaderPackDropZone.ActiveDrag .ShaderPackDropZoneIcon {
+  opacity: 1
+}
+
+.ShaderPackDropZone.Disabled {
+  opacity: .5;
+  pointer-events: none
+}
+
+.ShaderPackDiagnostics {
+  display: flex;
+  flex-direction: column;
+  font-size: 1rem;

+.ShaderPackDiagnostics .ShaderPackDiagnosticLocation {

+}
+
+.ShaderPackDiagnostics .ShaderPackDiagnosticVariants {
+  color: #a4a4a4;
+  margin-left: .5rem
+}

+  animation: SkyblockReachLogMote var(--duration) ease-in-out var(--delay) infinite alternate;
+  background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--island-glow), transparent 70%);
+  height: var(--size);
+  left: var(--x);
+  opacity: .12;
+  position: absolute;
+  top: var(--y);
+  width: var(--size)
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogMote.Violet {
+  background: radial-gradient(circle, #c37dff, transparent 70%)
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogBubble {
+  animation: SkyblockReachLogBubbleRise var(--duration) linear var(--delay) infinite, SkyblockReachLogBubbleSway calc(var(--duration)/4) ease-in-out var(--delay) infinite alternate;
+  height: 100%;
+  left: var(--left);
+  opacity: 0;
+  position: absolute;
+  top: 100%;
+  width: var(--size)
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogBubble:before {
+  background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, rgba(205, 222, 240, .8) 0 20%, rgba(60, 225, 195, .2) 45%, transparent 70%);
+  border: 1px solid rgba(60, 225, 195, .75);
+  border-radius: 50%;
+  box-sizing: border-box;
+  content: "";
+  height: var(--size);
+  left: 0;
+  position: absolute;
+  top: 0;
+  width: var(--size)
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockReachLogShaft {
+  0% {
+    opacity: .35;
+    transform: rotate(calc(var(--tilt) - 4deg))
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: rotate(calc(var(--tilt) + 4deg))
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockReachLogMote {
+  0% {
+    opacity: .08;
+    transform: translateZ(0) scale(.85)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: .3;
+    transform: translate3d(var(--drift-x), var(--drift-y), 0) scale(1.1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockReachLogBubbleRise {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translateZ(0)
+  }
+
+  10% {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+
+  80% {
+    opacity: .8
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translate3d(0, -100%, 0)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockReachLogBubbleSway {
+  0% {
+    translate: calc(var(--sway)*-1) 0
+  }
+
+  to {
+    translate: var(--sway) 0
+  }
+}
+
+@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {
+
+  .SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogMote,
+  .SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogShaft {
+    animation: none
+  }

+  .SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogBubble {

+  }
+}

+@keyframes SkyblockQuestNotificationFade {
+
+  0%,
+  to {
+    opacity: 0
+  }
+
+  10%,
+  85% {
+    opacity: 1
+  }

+
+@keyframes SkyblockQuestNotificationCelebrate {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translateY(.5rem) scale(.94)
+  }
+
+  8% {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: translateY(0) scale(1.03)
+  }
+
+  14%,
+  85% {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: translateY(0) scale(1)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translateY(-.35rem)
+  }

+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 0;

+  }

+@keyframes SkyblockQuestNotificationCheck {

+
+  60% {

+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+}

+@keyframes SkyblockQuestNotificationNext {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translateX(2rem)
+  }
+
+  8%,
+  90% {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: translateX(0)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translateY(-.35rem)
+  }

+.NxLaneFill {

+  left: 0;
+  position: absolute;
+  transition: width .9s linear
+}
+
+.NxPipe {
+  align-self: center;
+  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, currentColor 0 6px, transparent 6px 10px);
+  background-size: 10px 3px;
+  color: #838383;
+  display: block;
+  height: 3px;
+  margin-right: 5px;
+  position: relative
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Fuel {
+  color: #b6ff3b
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Water {
+  color: #3fd0f0
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Cryo {
+  color: #a8f0ff
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Power {
+  color: #f2c94c
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Waste {
+  color: #d9a73a
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Store {
+  color: #f2c94c
+}
+
+.NxPipe:after {
+  border: 4.5px solid transparent;
+  border-left: 5px solid;
+  border-right: 0;
+  content: "";
+  position: absolute;
+  right: -5px;
+  top: -3px
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Planned,
+.NxPipe.Step0 {
+  color: #838383
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Short {
+  color: #ffb914
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Short:before {
+  color: #fcd373;
+  content: "!";
+  font-size: 10px;
+  font-weight: 700;
+  left: 50%;
+  position: absolute;
+  top: -1.1em;
+  transform: translateX(-50%)
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Step1 {
+  animation: NxPipeFlow 1.6s linear infinite
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Step2 {
+  animation: NxPipeFlow .8s linear infinite
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Step3 {
+  animation: NxPipeFlow .45s linear infinite
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Step4 {
+  animation: NxPipeFlow .25s linear infinite
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Planned {
+  animation: none
+}
+
+@keyframes NxPipeFlow {
+  0% {
+    background-position: 0 0
+  }
+
+  to {
+    background-position: 10px 0
+  }
+}

+.NxGauge {

+}

+.NxGaugeNow,
+.NxGaugeSettle {

+  left: -3px;
+  margin-bottom: -2px;
+  position: absolute;
+  right: -3px;
+  transition: bottom .9s linear
+}
+
+.NxGaugeNow {

+.NxGaugeTicks {

+.NxGaugeTicks small {

+.NxStatus {

+  top: 0;

+}
+
+@keyframes Baf2RxSiren {

+  }
+}
+
+.Baf2RxCountdown {

+
+  to {

+  }

+.Baf2LookTarget {
